title: 40 Top Company Swag Ideas & Products
summary: Discover 40 top company swag ideas, from branded apparel and tech to drinkware and snacks. Find the best company-branded swag for your business.
body_markdown:
Company swag has come a long way from basic promotional pens and logo-covered giveaways. Today, the best company swag combines thoughtful design, everyday functionality, and products people genuinely want to use. Whether you're welcoming new hires, recognizing employees, or building relationships with clients, the right branded merchandise can strengthen connections, build loyalty, and keep your business top of mind.


‍


With so many company swag ideas to choose from, finding something that fits your brand, audience, and budget is easier than ever. Think premium drinkware for the daily commute, comfortable apparel for work and weekends, or curated snack boxes that turn an ordinary delivery into a memorable experience.


‍


Ready for some inspiration? We've rounded up 40 top company swag items across eight categories, with options ranging from affordable event giveaways to elevated corporate gifts.


‍


## Top 40 Company Swag Ideas This Year


Great corporate swag doesn't have to be complicated. The key is choosing high-quality products that reflect your brand and deliver real value.


Explore these company swag ideas for employees, customers, prospects, and events, including familiar brands, trending accessories, and useful everyday essentials.


‍


Not sure which products best represent your business? Our guide to the[best custom merch to match your brand](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/best-custom-merch-to-match-your-brand) can help you narrow your options.


‍


### Custom Apparel


Custom apparel remains a company swag favorite for good reason. From comfortable everyday tees to premium outerwear, branded clothing gives employees and customers something they'll actually enjoy wearing. The trick is choosing quality fabrics, flattering fits, and subtle customization to ensure each piece feels like a wardrobe staple.


‍


1. **MERCER+METTLE Stretch Jersey Crew,** from $21.69: Give your team an elevated alternative to the standard company T-shirt. This versatile moisture-wicking crewneck tee offers a polished look that transitions easily from the office to weekend plans.


‍


1. **Bella + Canvas Unisex Tri-blend Long Sleeve Tee** , from $24.49: Soft, comfortable, and easy to layer, this long-sleeve tee is a natural fit for casual company apparel. Its relaxed versatility makes it a great choice for team outings, onboarding kits, and everyday branded merchandise that employees can wear year-round.


‍


1. **Champion Powerblend Pullover Hoodie** , from $35.32: A cozy hoodie is one of those company swag items that rarely goes out of style. This Champion pullover features double dry technology to wick away moisture. It’s a recognizable brand that brings casual comfort to team merchandise. Customize it with your company logo for employee appreciation gifts, retreats, or seasonal giveaways.


‍


1. **Nike Women's Club Fleece Sleeve Swoosh 1/2-Zip** , from $70.07: Looking for corporate swag with a premium athletic feel? This Nike half-zip offers a sporty, polished alternative to traditional branded sweatshirts. It's an excellent option for employee milestones, leadership gifts, and teams that appreciate recognizable name-brand apparel.


‍


1. **The North Face Women's Ambition 1/4-Zip** , from $79.22: Infuse performance-inspired style in your employee swag collection with this versatile quarter-zip. Ideal for layering during commutes, outdoor events, and active weekends, it delivers the quality and brand recognition that make premium company apparel especially appealing.


‍


Want your branded apparel to stand out? Explore different[ways to customize a T-shirt](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/ways-to-customize-a-tee-shirt) , from screen printing to embroidery, to find the right look for your brand.


‍


### Branded Hats and Headwear


Hats are among the most versatile company swag ideas because they're practical, easy to customize, and available in styles to suit almost any audience. Whether your brand leans sporty, outdoorsy, or fashion-forward, there's a headwear option that can help keep your logo visible long after an event ends.


1. **Port Authority Garment Washed Cap** , from $14.53: Sometimes the best company swag is something simple that works with nearly anything. This casual cap has an easygoing, worn-in look that makes it ideal for employee events, branded welcome kits, and everyday wear. It's also an accessible option for larger merchandise orders.


‍


1. **AS Colour Terry Bucket Hat** , from $19.03: Add a playful, trend-forward option to your corporate swag collection. The textured terry fabric gives this bucket hat a laid-back look that's especially well suited for summer events, company retreats, beach outings, and lifestyle-focused brands.


‍


1. **AS Colour Class Cord Trucker Cap** , from $18.17: This corduroy-inspired trucker cap brings a vintage aesthetic to modern company merchandise. Its distinctive texture makes it a memorable choice for creative teams, branded merchandise collections, and companies looking for swag that feels more like retail apparel.


‍


1. **The North Face Circular Rib Beanie** , from $28.33: Keep employees warm while giving your brand a little extra visibility. The North Face cozy beanie makes a thoughtful addition to winter swag boxes, outdoor event giveaways, and holiday appreciation gifts. A small embroidered logo creates a clean, understated finish.


‍


1. **Nike Dri-FIT Team Performance Visor** , from $23.90: Perfect for company golf outings, outdoor team events, and active employees, this Nike visor offers a sporty alternative to traditional caps. It's a particularly fitting choice for wellness initiatives, tournaments, and summer employee swag.


‍


### Branded Drinkware


Reusable drinkware is one of the most practical categories of company swag, offering something recipients can use throughout the workday and beyond. Premium tumblers, insulated mugs, and water bottles also provide attractive branding opportunities without sacrificing style.


For companies prioritizing sustainability, reusable drinkware can support efforts to reduce reliance on disposable cups and bottles. Look for products with recycled materials or verified sourcing certifications when those qualities align with your company's environmental goals.


1. **CamelBak 30oz. Thrive Tumbler** , from $38: Built for busy schedules, this insulated tumbler keeps drinks cold for up to 19 hours and hot for up to eight. A leakproof lid, non-slip bumper, and cup-holder-friendly design make it a useful companion for commutes, road trips, and everyday hydration.


‍


1. **CORKCICLE Go Cup XL 30 Oz.** , from $30: Stylish enough for a desk and practical enough for life on the go, this generously sized tumbler features triple insulation, a non-slip bottom, and a leakproof lid with a high-flow straw. Its wide opening also makes adding ice and cleaning easier.


‍


1. **Fellow Carter Slide Tumbler 16 oz.** , from $34.95: Coffee lovers will appreciate this thoughtfully designed tumbler, featuring a thumb-operated sliding lid and a ceramic interior coating that helps preserve the flavor of their favorite brew. Its slim silhouette and insulation make it ideal for morning commutes and coffee-focused employee gifts.


‍


1. **Klean Kanteen Rise 12 Oz. Mug** , from $32.95: Make coffee breaks a little more sustainable with this insulated mug made from recycled stainless steel. It features a comfortable handle, splash-proof lid, and durable finish, plus insulation that keeps beverages hot for up to four hours. It's a smart addition to environmentally minded corporate swag programs.


‍


1. **Owala FreeSip Sway** , from $54.68: Give your company swag collection a fresh, contemporary feel with this Owala water bottle. The brand's recognizable style makes it a fun alternative to conventional promotional bottles, especially for employee wellness programs, onboarding gifts, and lifestyle-focused swag boxes.


‍

Bags offer plenty of room for creative customization while delivering long-term usefulness. From affordable totes to premium backpacks and professional work bags, these corporate swag ideas can accompany recipients to meetings, airports, grocery stores, and everywhere in between.

With its generous 30-liter capacity and recognizable outdoor-inspired styling, this Cotopaxi bag is an excellent choice for employee milestones, executive appreciation, and higher-end corporate gifting.


‍


1. **MERCER+METTLE Weekend Tote** , from $54.24: A versatile weekend tote offers a stylish way to carry clothing, personal essentials, and travel accessories. Its understated design makes it a natural fit for company retreats, employee welcome gifts, and branded merchandise collections that favor a more refined look.


‍


1. **The North Face 25L Travel Tote** , from $116.62: Designed with busy commuters and frequent travelers in mind, this versatile tote includes a padded laptop compartment, organizational pockets, and a luggage pass-through. Carry it by the top handles or removable shoulder strap for a flexible everyday work bag.


‍


1. **Port Authority Ideal Twill Jumbo Tote** , from $15.47: Affordable, roomy, and easy to customize, this classic tote is a dependable choice for conferences, trade shows, and large-scale company events. Its generous size makes it especially useful for carrying event materials, merchandise, and everyday essentials.


‍


1. **TravisMathew Lateral Brief** , from $83.85: Give professional essentials a stylish upgrade with this TravisMathew brief. Its polished appearance makes it an appealing choice for sales teams, business travelers, and employees who regularly move between meetings and office locations.

‍

## Frequently Asked Questions About Company Swag


‍


### What's the most popular company swag item for a general office?


Branded drinkware, comfortable apparel, tote bags, and notebooks are consistently practical options for general office environments. These products appeal to a wide audience and fit naturally into everyday routines. For a versatile starting point, consider insulated tumblers, premium tees, or reusable totes that balance quality with affordability.


‍


### How much should a company budget per employee for swag?


The right budget depends on the occasion, product quality, customization, and order quantity. As a general planning guideline, companies might allocate $15 to $30 per person for simple giveaways, $30 to $75 for employee welcome kits, and $75 to $150 or more for premium appreciation gifts. Remember to account for customization, packaging, shipping, and any applicable order minimums when calculating the total cost.


‍


### What's good company swag for a hybrid or remote team?


The best swag for employees who work remotely supports their daily routines or adds comfort to their home environment. Wireless chargers, notebooks, insulated drinkware, cozy apparel, and curated snack boxes are all excellent choices. You can also combine multiple products into a personalized work-from-home gift kit.


‍


### Can Gemnote curate a swag box with products from different categories?


Yes! Gemnote helps companies create curated swag boxes that combine complementary merchandise from different categories. For example, you could pair a branded tumbler with a premium notebook, snacks, and a comfortable hoodie for a memorable employee welcome gift. Custom packaging can help bring the entire experience together.


‍


### What's the difference between swag for employees and swag for clients or prospects?


Employee swag typically focuses on appreciation, team connection, and everyday usefulness. Popular choices include branded apparel, desk accessories, wellness products, and milestone gifts. Client and prospect swag often serves a different purpose, such as building awareness, strengthening relationships, or creating a memorable first impression. In either case, high-quality products and thoughtful presentation help make your branded merchandise more effective.
